prompt: Some students choose to work or travel after leaving school and before going to university. Many people, however, say that working experience is more useful in adult life than travel.Do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
After graduation and before university intake, students have a choice whether to work or travel. While some people believe that work is a better option, as it will support them in their adult life, I side with those who choose travel after leaving school.

On the one hand, working is good to prepare students with practical skills. Nowadays, there are opportunities for them to gain working experience, such as register an internship in a company or get a part-time job in a restaurant. It will teach them how to be more disciplined and responsible, as they have to come on time and perform well in their job. However, this experience will not significantly help them in their future life, because their age only makes it possible to get practical and boring stuff, like becoming a photocopier or a waitress.

On the other hand, travel brings more lessons and joy at the same time. To begin with, a touring is actually an experimental learning process, where students will learn that their holiday plan may not go well. For example, one day, they decided to go to a beach, but suddenly rain fall, and it ruined their itinerary. They need to adjust and discuss what the best solution for this problem is. As a result, it will boost their problem solving skill. Furthermore, a holiday with friends will strengthen their relationship, and they can have good quality time before separation in the university, as they may not get into the same institution as well as same major. It is better for them to use their free moment to explore, because by the day they get into the next stage, they will get busier with tons of assignments.

In conclusion, though some people say working will help students in the future, I think it is better for them to explore places, because they are still young and free. After leaving school, they are still in their teenage period, which only permits them to get blue-collar jobs. In contrast, travel is more suitable for their age to explore and gain knowledge through experience. Not only learning, but vacation also brings fun and unforgettable memories for them with their friends.
